title: Provide parallel machine- and human-readable ontology representations
abstract: A Tarium member project's ontology must have both machine-readable and human-readable representations of the same underlying information; structured JSON and explanatory Markdown are examples, not an imposed exclusive file format.
unresolved: The formal synchronization or derivation rule is left for specimen processing.
